source.name: HC Admiral official site: 'OLIMPBET продлевает партнерство с ХК «Адмирал» еще на три года'
source.quote: Букмекерская компания OLIMPBET и хоккейный клуб «Адмирал» объявили о продлении сотрудничества еще на три года.
source.note: Club announcement (26 Mar 2025): Olimpbet partnership, begun in 2024/25, extended for three more years. Current-season (2026-27) player portraits on hcadmiral.pro/team/players/ show gold OLIMPBET lettering across the lower front of the black home jersey; shaiba.kz reported at signing (2024-09-03) that the bookmaker's logo would appear on the game jersey.

source.name: HC Admiral official photo gallery: '«Адмирал» - «Нефтехимик» — 3:5' (27 Sep 2026)
source.note: Match photo from the club's official gallery (opened 2026-10-03) shows a small white T-Bank (yellow T logo) patch sewn on the upper back of the 2026-27 home jersey. T-Bank is a KHL general partner, listed in the league sponsor board on hcadmiral.pro ('Партнёры Фонбет Чемпионата КХЛ сезона 2026/2027'), so this is recorded as a league-partner placement.

summary: 2026-27 home kit. Olimpbet (OLIMPBET lettering across the lower front) per the club's 2025-03-26 partnership-extension announcement and current player portraits. A T-Bank league patch sits on the upper back in match photos. No sponsor logos seen on sleeves or pants in September 2026 match photos; helmet decals could not be identified, so the list is not marked complete.
